name: Salmon
description: Fatty fish prized for its high omega-3 content, rich flavor, and firm texture. A staple of Mediterranean and Nordic diets, salmon is versatile enough for grilling, baking, pan-searing, and raw preparations.

faqs.q: Is salmon good for heart health?
faqs.a: Yes. Salmon is one of the best dietary sources of EPA and DHA omega-3 fatty acids, which are linked to lower triglycerides, reduced blood pressure, and a lower risk of cardiovascular disease.

faqs.q: Should I buy wild or farmed salmon?
faqs.a: Wild salmon typically has fewer calories, less saturated fat, and a slightly higher mineral content. Farmed salmon tends to be higher in overall omega-3s but also higher in saturated fat. Both can be part of a healthy diet.
